playstyle: Three elite Stormcast Sequitors with solid health but only a single shield save, moving at a steady pace with no innate speed tricks. Averon leads with a range 2 hammer, Ammis staggers foes and Rastus cleaves through defences, while all three carry ranged sword attacks for chip damage. Inspiring sharply boosts their dice and damage, so the warband wins by holding objectives or treasure with tightly grouped, durable bodies, trading blows efficiently and leaning on its chosen Order warscroll for territorial control.
